purpose: Definitions of the labeled sets used to measure screening accuracy (include/exclude) and tag agreement. Built by pipeline/validation/build_eval_set.py (to be written).

jips_curated.description: All papers listed in JIPS monthly 'placebo/nocebo publications' posts (2016-2025). Hand-selected by Enck/Weimer editors; treat as gold INCLUDE.
jips_curated.source: https://jips.online/ monthly posts; parse citation + DOI + PMID; resolve via PubMed efetch for abstract/MeSH/pubtypes
jips_curated.holdout: Stratified 20% by year held out for final reporting; the rest available for prompt tuning.

paperpile_placebo.description: Paperpile PDFs whose filename contains 'placebo' (~716). Author-curated; mostly INCLUDE but contains some efficacy RCTs. Use as a secondary positive set after a quick manual pass on ~100.

pubmed_placebo_controlled_rct.description: Efficacy RCTs that use a placebo control but do not study the placebo effect. Gold EXCLUDE (after light manual audit of ~150 to remove the ~2-5% that do analyze placebo response).
pubmed_placebo_controlled_rct.pubmed_query: ("Randomized Controlled Trial"[pt] AND placebo[tiab] AND (efficacy[tiab] OR versus placebo[tiab] OR compared with placebo[tiab]) NOT ("placebo effect"[tiab] OR "placebo effects"[tiab] OR "placebo response"[tiab] OR "placebo responses"[tiab] OR nocebo[tiab] OR expectan*[tiab] OR "open-label placebo"[tiab] OR "Placebo Effect"[mh])) AND 2016:2025[dp] AND english[la]
pubmed_placebo_controlled_rct.sampling: Random 1500 PMIDs, stratified by year and by the JIPS journal distribution where possible so negatives resemble positives in topic/venue.
pubmed_placebo_controlled_rct.note: This is the hard negative class: abstracts contain the word 'placebo' throughout.

pubmed_hard_negatives_placebo_response_m.description: Efficacy RCTs and drug meta-analyses whose abstracts mention 'placebo response' or 'placebo group improved' only descriptively. Manually labeled (n~200). These calibrate the 'placebo is comparator only' rule.
pubmed_hard_negatives_placebo_response_m.pubmed_query: ("Randomized Controlled Trial"[pt] OR "Meta-Analysis"[pt]) AND ("placebo response"[tiab] OR "placebo group"[tiab]) AND (efficacy[ti] OR versus[ti] OR vs[ti]) AND 2016:2025[dp]
pubmed_hard_negatives_placebo_response_m.labeling: Two raters (Tor + one lab member) label 200; disagreements adjudicated. Gives inter-rater kappa as the ceiling for model performance.

pubmed_topical_noise.description: Papers that a broad daily query would surface but are off-topic: 'placebo' in MeSH only, pharmacology reviews, trial protocols of drugs. Random 500 from the daily discovery query minus the positives.
pubmed_topical_noise.pubmed_query: placebo[tiab] AND 2016:2025[dp] NOT ("placebo effect"[tiab] OR nocebo[tiab] OR expectan*[tiab])

screening: MCC for include vs exclude (uncertain counted as include for recall, as exclude for precision; report both)
calibration: reliability diagram of confidence vs accuracy in 10 bins; ECE
tagging: per-axis micro/macro F1 vs human tags on 200 papers (2 raters)
exact-match rate for single-valued axes (article_type, species)

targets.uncertain_rate: <= 10% (those go to a human review queue)
targets.tag_macro_F1: >= 0.75 on major axes (study_focus, design, condition_domain, article_type)

procedure: 1. Build sets; dedupe by DOI/PMID; drop any paper present in both positives and negatives.
2. Split: dev (60%) / test (40%) with stratification by year and set.
3. Run every candidate model on dev with prompt v1 via Batch API (50% off); compute metrics; inspect 50 false negatives + 50 false positives per model.
4. Revise prompt rules (not the taxonomy ids) -> v1.1; re-run on dev only. Freeze.
5. Report test-set metrics once per model; pick default model; record in docs/validation.md with date, model ids, prompt_version, taxonomy_version.

6. Ongoing: sample 20 random includes + 10 excludes/week for spot review; log corrections in record.review; recompute metrics quarterly; re-run classification when prompt_version or taxonomy_version changes.
